endpoints.name: Bounty Engineer Agent Commerce API
endpoints.description: Calculate the downstream financial blast radius of a proposed agent action over a dependency graph and block plans that exceed declared exposure or critical-node limits before execution.

endpoints.name: Bounty Engineer Agent Commerce API
endpoints.description: Simulate a full autonomous task DAG before execution using declared costs, success rates, dependencies, failure costs and latency; return expected spend, mission success probability, failure-cost exposure and fragility hotspots.

endpoints.name: Bounty Engineer Agent Commerce API
endpoints.description: Compile an entire multi-agent mission before execution: choose subcontractors, price the plan, simulate mission success and failure cost, calculate downstream blast radius, and return one hashed machine-execution contract.

endpoints.name: Bounty Engineer Agent Commerce API
endpoints.description: Turn a complex task graph into a machine-ready subcontracting mesh: assign the best declared agent to every task, select fallbacks, enforce task price caps, project total spend and estimate whole-mission success.

endpoints.name: Bounty Engineer Agent Commerce API
endpoints.description: Recover from agent-to-agent payment deadlocks: reconcile repeated x402 HTTP 402 challenges, detect changed payees and network drift, block budget violations and duplicate paid side effects, and compile the next safe action. No payment or retry is performed by this product.

endpoints.name: Bounty Engineer Agent Commerce API
endpoints.description: Event-native incident evidence for non-AI systems: IoT sensor gateways, CI/CD release hooks, data pipelines, inventory/event buses and ordinary cron jobs. CloudEvents 1.0 anomalies, sequence gaps, timestamp drift, forbidden types and numeric thresholds produce deterministic incident fingerprints and review actions, paid only when buyer software chooses to invoke the evidence endpoint after the free anomaly quote.

endpoints.name: Bounty Engineer Agent Commerce API
endpoints.description: Live, independent npm dependency release risk evidence for non-AI package managers, CI/CD runners and deployment controllers. Check pinned sha512 integrity, lifecycle scripts, optional npm signature/provenance metadata and known OSV vulnerabilities before installing an exact package version. Live registry+OSV preflight runs prior to payment settlement, and errors prevent fulfillment; buyer authorization is required.

endpoints.name: Bounty Engineer Agent Commerce API
endpoints.description: Independent read-only Base mainnet USDC transaction receipt evidence for digital treasuries, DAO payment systems, automated accounts-payable, business settlement, enterprise payment agents and recurring invoice processors. Compare up to eight exact transaction hashes against buyer-declared recipient, sender, minimum amount, age and confirmations, detect duplicate invoice mapping and mismatched transfers, and return source-derived hashed evidence. No private keys, signing, fund recovery, card rai

endpoints.name: Bounty Engineer Agent Commerce API
endpoints.description: Independent public GitHub pull-request head/CI verification for funded agent collaborations and automated code deliverables. Query live changed files, test-change presence, required CI statuses and exact head SHA; expose concrete reviewer blockers with a source-derived fingerprint before human or contract acceptance. No repository code is run and no claim of functional patch correctness is made.

endpoints.name: Bounty Engineer Agent Commerce API
endpoints.description: Machine-native deterministic JSON before/after state change policy evaluation for rule-based CI/CD jobs, inventory event processors, non-AI scheduler pipelines, billing record reconciliation and automated deployments. SHA-256 checksums of caller-supplied JSON, changed JSON pointers, baseline assertions, blocked-field and regression policy checks. Does NOT independently verify origin, external measurements, cryptographic signatures or machine owner consent; purchase only by authorized buyers.

endpoints.name: Bounty Engineer Agent Commerce API
endpoints.description: Optimize savings across multiple recurring agent API purchases. Unlock exact lower-cost routes and fallback plans for up to five purchases after a free quote, only when projected aggregate savings are at least five times the fee.

endpoints.name: Bounty Engineer Agent Commerce API
endpoints.description: Find a cheaper callable API route and reduce agent purchase cost after a free Margin Exchange quote. Unlock the exact lower-cost provider route, fallback chain and switch economics only when projected savings are at least five times this fee.

endpoints.name: Bounty Engineer Agent Commerce API
endpoints.description: Rank a bounded TED search against supplier capabilities, with transparent relevance reasons and source links. Not a qualification or win prediction.

endpoints.name: Bounty Engineer Agent Commerce API
endpoints.description: Search current TED procurement notices with country, CPV and keyword filters. Up to 100 notices; not exhaustive coverage.

endpoints.name: Cloud Document AI API
endpoints.description: Extract structured data from PDFs, scans, and document images using OCR and ML. Handles invoices, receipts, forms, contracts, tax documents, IDs, and custom schemas, returning text, tables, entities, fields, and confidence signals.

endpoints.name: Cloud Natural Language API
endpoints.description: Analyze text with Google NLP: sentiment, emotion, named entities, entity salience, content categories, moderation categories, syntax, and all-in-one annotation. Supports multilingual text analytics for documents, reviews, tickets, and articles.

endpoints.name: Cloud Speech-to-Text API
endpoints.description: Convert speech audio to text with Google Speech-to-Text. Supports 125+ languages, short and long audio, streaming-style workflows, speaker diarization, word timestamps, phrase hints, custom classes, profanity filtering, and punctuation.

endpoints.name: Cloud Text-to-Speech API
endpoints.description: Generate natural-sounding speech from text or SSML in 50+ languages and 380+ voices. Supports pitch, speed, effects profiles, MP3/WAV/OGG output, long-form synthesis, and Neural2/Studio voice models for production audio.

endpoints.name: Cloud Translation API
endpoints.description: Translate text and documents across 130+ languages. Supports language detection, romanization, synchronous and batch translation, glossaries for domain terminology, adaptive MT datasets, custom models, and document formatting.

endpoints.name: Cloud Video Intelligence API
endpoints.description: Analyze video content asynchronously with Google Video Intelligence. Detect labels, shots, explicit content, speech, on-screen text, logos, object tracks, scene changes, and searchable metadata for uploaded or cloud-hosted videos.

endpoints.name: Cloud Vision API
endpoints.description: Analyze images with Google Cloud Vision ML. Detect objects, faces, text/OCR, labels, landmarks, logos, safe-search signals, web entities, crop hints, dominant colors, and product-search reference images across image, PDF, and TIFF inputs.

endpoints.description: Crawl a website: fetch a page, follow the links inside the same host and return every page it reached, within a page budget you set. For reading documentation, a product catalogue or a changelog in one paid call instead of many.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Fetch any public web page or JSON API and get its status, content type, headers and body back. For agents that need to read a page they cannot reach themselves. Private networks and loopback addresses are blocked, and large bodies are truncated rather than dropped.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Search the live web and get ranked results back: title, URL and snippet for each hit, up to 20 per call, optionally biased to a country. The natural first step before fetching or crawling - this tool finds the pages, the fetch and crawl tools read them. Results come from an independent web index and the response names which one answered.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Current weather and a short forecast for anywhere on earth, by place name or by latitude and longitude. Returns temperature, apparent temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind speed and direction, plus a daily high and low for up to seven days. Place names are geocoded for you.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Make any read-only JSON-RPC call on 28 EVM chains - eth_call, eth_blockNumber, eth_getLogs, eth_getBalance and the rest - without running a node or holding an RPC key. Covers Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC and more, with automatic failover across providers when one rate-limits or goes down.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Look up any transaction and its receipt by hash on 28 EVM chains: success or revert, block number, gas used, effective gas price, sender and recipient. Covers Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC and more. Use it to confirm a payment or settlement actually landed.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Read any wallet balance on 28 EVM chains: native coin (ETH, BNB, MATIC, AVAX) or any ERC-20 token including USDC. Covers Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, zkSync, Linea, Scroll, Blast, Mantle, Celo, Gnosis, Sonic, Unichain, World Chain, Zora and more. Returns the raw and decimal balance with the block it was read at.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Hourly electricity generation by fuel source for any US balancing authority, with the carbon-free share computed from wind, solar, hydro, nuclear and geothermal. Storage is excluded from both sides because discharging shifts power rather than generating it, and "other/unknown" is never counted as clean - so the share errs low. Method returned with the numbers.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Hourly US electricity demand, day-ahead demand forecast, net generation and total interchange for any of 83 balancing authorities - CAISO, ERCOT, PJM, MISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP, Bonneville, or US48 for the whole Lower 48. Straight from EIA open data, grouped by hour so an agent reads one object per hour instead of four raw series.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Screen a person, company or vessel name against the US Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list AND its alias file - aliases matter, because a sanctioned party usually trades under an aka. Each match carries a deterministic score, the sanctions programme, and whether the hit was a primary name or an alias. The response lists which lists were searched and which were not: a name-similarity search, not a compliance determination.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Look up a CVE by id, or search the NVD catalogue by keyword. Returns the CVSS base score and vector with its version (v4, v3.1, v3.0 or v2 - whichever NVD published), severity, CWE classification, publication and last-modified dates, vulnerability status and references. Straight from the NIST National Vulnerability Database.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Euro foreign-exchange reference rates from the European Central Bank for 30 currencies - USD, GBP, JPY, CHF, TRY, CNY, INR, BRL and more - with cross-rates derived through EUR (USD/TRY, GBP/JPY, anything against anything) and an optional daily series up to 90 business days. The response says plainly what these are: published once per business day around 16:00 CET, not a live market rate and not tradeable.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Read an NFT collection and optionally one token from the chain: ERC-721 or ERC-1155, name, symbol, total supply, the token's owner and its metadata (name, description, image, attributes) with IPFS and Arweave resolved. Metadata hosts are fetched through the same private-network guard as web-fetch. Read-only, no key.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Resolve an ENS name or a Basename (*.eth, *.base.eth) to its address and avatar, or an address to its primary name on Ethereum and on Base. Reverse answers are forward-verified, so a name is only returned if it resolves back to the address. Read-only, no key.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Current gas fees on any of the supported EVM chains from the last 20 blocks: next-block base fee, slow/normal/fast priority fees (10th/50th/90th percentile, median across blocks), a suggested max fee and what a plain transfer costs in native token and USD. Read-only, no key.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: How much token_out a swap returns right now: direct pools and the route through the wrapped native token, across Uniswap V2/V3 (PancakeSwap on BNB Chain) and every fee tier, with price impact and the pools on the route. Quotes only - nothing is built, signed or sent.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Current USD and native price of any ERC-20 by contract address, read straight from the deepest Uniswap V2/V3 pool (PancakeSwap on BNB Chain) against the wrapped native token and converted through the deepest stablecoin pool. Base, Arbitrum, BNB Chain; Robinhood Chain in native terms. Returns the pool used, its depth and a thin-liquidity warning. No API key.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Read a token's DEX pair straight from the chain: pair address, both reserves, the implied price, LP total supply and how much of that LP sits in burn addresses. Base, Arbitrum and BNB Chain, Uniswap V2-style factories against the wrapped native token. Read-only eth_call, no API key. The answer states its own limits: no pair here does not mean no liquidity, because V3, other DEXes and non-native quote pairs are not covered.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Replace personal data in text with typed placeholders. Emails, phone numbers, cards, IBANs and IP addresses are matched by exact pattern and never left to the model - the deterministic cases cannot be missed. Names, addresses and ids are judged by a model, and output shorter than half the input is rejected, so redaction never silently deletes text. The method is returned with the result.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Sentiment as one of positive, negative, neutral or mixed, with a -1 to 1 score and a one-line reason. "Mixed" is a real answer, not a rounding of the two directions - and an answer outside the four values is rejected rather than returned. Fixed price per call.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Translate text into any target language, detecting the source when you do not give it. Proper nouns, numbers, code and formatting are kept as they are. Returns the translation alone, with no preamble to strip. Fixed price per call.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Summarize text into a set number of sentences, or into bullet points. Uses only what the text says and adds nothing. Input is bounded at 8000 characters, which is what makes a fixed price per call possible instead of per-token billing.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Pull named fields out of free text as JSON - names, dates, amounts, references, anything you list. Every field you ask for appears in the answer: one the text does not contain comes back null rather than guessed, so "not in the text" and "model did not answer" are never confused. Fixed price per call.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Assign text to one of the labels you supply - support tickets, intents, topics, spam or not, anything. The returned label is checked against your list, so the model cannot invent a category: an answer outside your labels is rejected rather than passed through. Comes back with a confidence and a one-line reason. Fixed price per call.

Professional market data API for crypto derivatives, spot markets, prediction markets, Hyperliquid HyperCore data, proprietary volatility surfaces, and analytics.

## Authentication

Use an API key for authenticated REST requests:


endpoints.name: ProofKit — signed, offline-checkable receipts for compute you already ran
endpoints.description: POST a canonical string plus an Ed25519 signature, and optionally a pinned key, to get SIGNATURE VALID / SIGNATURE INVALID / UNKNOWN. The probe body is deliberately invalid, so SIGNATURE INVALID at HTTP 200 is the expected live answer; UNKNOWN is returned instead of INVALID whenever the check could not be performed. It verifies a signature over the exact bytes you supply and does not claim those bytes describe any payload you saw.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Search Hacker News stories by keyword over the last day, week or year, with points, comments and links. Use it to find what the developer community is discussing about a technology right now.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI

endpoints.description: MET Norway forecast for coordinates, with 3-day coverage, temperature, wind and humidity. Licensed CC BY 4.0 / NLOD, cached with attribution. Forecast, not instrument observation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Check whether a specific package version has known vulnerabilities, across npm and PyPI, using the Open Source Vulnerabilities database. Use it as a supply-chain check: given a package and a version, say whether installing it would bring in a known CVE, and which version fixes it.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up a CVE in the US National Vulnerability Database: description, CVSS score and severity, affected weakness (CWE) identifiers and reference links. Use it to check whether a vulnerability a scanner reported is real and how severe it is, before deciding what to patch first.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Static code review of a source snippet: security problems, bugs and code smells, each with a severity and a message, plus an overall quality score. Use it to review code before merging, to find hardcoded secrets and unsafe patterns, or to get a second opinion on a diff. Accepts source code in any language.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: WHOIS and RDAP lookup for a domain: is it registered or AVAILABLE for purchase, registrar, creation and expiry dates, and status codes. Use it to check whether a domain name is free before buying it, to find when one expires, or to read ownership and nameserver details.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Trending GitHub repositories for a daily, weekly or monthly window, with stars, primary language and description. Use it to see what developers are shipping right now, to scout new libraries, or to find examples of a technique.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Resolve DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME) for a domain against two independent resolvers (Cloudflare and Google) and report whether their answers agree. Use it for DNS lookup, MX record checks, SPF/DKIM TXT inspection, nameserver discovery, or to debug propagation and mail routing.
